agency: Ostrander Valley Recreation and Park District (fictional)

findings.title: Agency is a local agency
findings.detail: Recorded as a special district (recreation and park district). The chapter does not define “special district”, so confirm this entity qualifies.

findings.title: Not a state-owned or state-operated facility
findings.detail: The project is not on a state-owned or state-operated facility.

findings.title: Project value exceeds $5,000,000
findings.detail: Estimated cost is $5,000,000; the statute requires more than $5,000,000 (exactly the threshold is not “in excess of” it).

findings.title: Agency project count stays within 10
findings.detail: This would be project 11 of 10 (10 earlier). The cap is exceeded. The agency also reports 1 project(s) under the separate water-agency chapter 4.1 (SB 991); the engine does not count those here.

findings.title: Procurement falls inside the chapter’s life
findings.detail: RFQ issue 2028-10-02, contract award 2029-02-12 fall before the 2030-01-01 repeal (1133 days from 2026-11-25). But phase 2 amendment (2030-03-01) and expected completion (2031-08-30) would come on or after repeal, and the chapter does not address contracts in progress at that date.

findings.title: Organizational conflict-of-interest guidelines developed
findings.detail: Agency has not developed the required guidelines.

findings.title: Size, type, and desired design character of the project
findings.detail: Present.

findings.title: Expected cost range
findings.detail: Missing from the RFQ.

findings.title: Methodology for evaluating qualifications
findings.detail: Present.

findings.title: Procedure for final selection
findings.detail: Present.

findings.title: Significant factors the agency expects to consider, including technical design and construction expertise
findings.detail: Present.

findings.title: Relative importance or weight of each factor
findings.detail: Missing from the RFQ.

findings.detail: Present.

findings.title: Certification under penalty of perjury by the design-build entity and its general partners or joint venture members
findings.detail: Missing from the RFQ.

findings.title: Template asks for: Listing of shareholders, partners, or members who will perform work (privately held entities)
findings.detail: Present.

findings.title: Template asks for: Evidence of experience and capacity, key personnel, and a financial statement
findings.detail: Present.

findings.detail: Present.

findings.title: Template asks for: Capacity to obtain payment and performance bonds, liability insurance, and errors and omissions insurance
findings.detail: Present.

findings.title: Template asks for: Workers’ compensation experience history and worker safety program
findings.detail: Missing from the template.

findings.title: Template asks for: Organizational documents or agreement committing to form the organization
findings.detail: Present.

findings.title: Template asks for: An acceptable safety record
findings.detail: Missing from the template.

findings.title: Every listed factor has a weight
findings.detail: No weight for: Technical approach.

findings.title: Price is not the sole basis of award
findings.detail: 1 weighted non-price factor(s).

findings.title: Bid documents give notice of the skilled and trained workforce requirement
findings.detail: Notice is missing. Under § 2600.5 the omission does not excuse the requirement.

findings.title: Acceptable safety record
findings.detail: Three-year average EMR 1.070 (limit 1.00); recordable rate 3.4 vs standard 2.8; lost work rate 1.2 vs standard 1.4.

findings.title: Information certified under penalty of perjury
findings.detail: Entity certified, but not all general partners or joint venture members did.

findings.title: Skilled and trained workforce commitment or exception
findings.detail: No enforceable commitment and no project labor agreement exception. The entity “shall not be evaluated for selection”.

findings.title: Organizational conflict of interest
findings.citation: Pub. Cont. Code § 22185.2; Gov. Code § 1090; People v. Superior Court (Sahlolbei)
findings.detail: Quillfeather Program Advisors performed services for the agency relating to this solicitation. Apply the agency’s § 22185.2 guidelines. The research report also points to Gov. Code § 1090; that statute was not read for this build.

findings.title: Acceptable safety record
findings.detail: Three-year average EMR 0.927 (limit 1.00); recordable rate 2 vs standard 2.8; lost work rate 1 vs standard 1.4.

findings.title: Information certified under penalty of perjury
findings.detail: Certified by the entity.

findings.title: Skilled and trained workforce commitment or exception
findings.detail: Renewal of an agency project labor agreement first entered 2023-06-15; the exception needs a date before 2023-01-01 (§ 22185.3(b)(2)(B)).

findings.title: Award publicly announced with the awardee named
findings.detail: Announced.

findings.title: Statement of the basis of the award
findings.detail: No basis-of-award statement recorded. The statement and contract file must be enough to satisfy an external audit.

findings.title: Payment bond is at least the performance bond
findings.detail: Payment bond $5,400,000; performance bond $10,800,000. Short by $5,400,000.

findings.title: Bonds issued by a California admitted surety
findings.detail: Surety recorded as California admitted.

findings.title: Contract requires errors and omissions insurance for design
findings.detail: Not required in the contract.

findings.title: Agency has a standard bond form for design-build projects
findings.detail: No standard form recorded.

findings.title: Cost against the guaranteed maximum price
findings.detail: Projected cost $13,150,000 exceeds the guaranteed maximum price $12,400,000 by $750,000. That excess is the design-build entity’s responsibility.

findings.title: Shared savings rest on a prior written agreement
findings.detail: The contract gives the entity 50% of savings without a prior written agreement.

findings.title: Overruns above the guaranteed maximum price stay with the entity
findings.detail: A contract clause moves overruns to the agency. The statute allows an amendment for unforeseen site conditions; anything broader conflicts with it.

findings.title: No retention on work to establish the guaranteed maximum price
findings.detail: Phase 1 retention is 5%; it must be zero.

findings.title: Retention from the design-build entity is at most 5%
findings.detail: Rate is 10%; cap is 5% because bonds are required in the solicitation.

findings.title: Subcontract retention does not exceed the prime rate: Varga Mechanical
findings.detail: Subcontract rate 15%; prime rate 10%. No bond-notice exception recorded.

findings.title: Subcontract award threshold
findings.detail: Threshold is $54,000 (0.5% of $10,800,000 allocable to construction.) Subcontracts above it, other than those listed in the statement of qualifications, need the § 22185.6(b) process.

findings.title: Varga Mechanical ($1,900,000)
findings.detail: Above the $54,000 threshold by $1,846,000. Missing: public notice of the work; a fixed date and time for submissions; award on a best value basis (recorded: low_bid).

findings.title: Lindqvist Pool Systems ($54,000)
findings.detail: At or below the $54,000 threshold.

findings.title: Corbel Glass ($54,001)
findings.detail: Above the $54,000 threshold by $1. Public notice, criteria, and best value award are recorded.

findings.title: Pallister Crane Constructors LLC · plumber · 2029-09
findings.detail: Required 60% graduates. By headcount 5/10 = 50.0%. By hours 800/1500 = 53.3%. Neither test is met. The agency must withhold $330,000 (150% of the $220,000 monthly billing) until a compliance plan is provided, and forward the report to the Labor Commissioner (§ 2602(c)).

findings.title: Varga Mechanical · sheet metal worker · 2029-09
findings.detail: No complete monthly report. The agency must withhold further payments until one is provided; where a subcontractor caused the gap, the withholding is $144,000 (150% of its $96,000 billing).

findings.title: Pallister Crane Constructors LLC · teamster · 2029-09
findings.detail: The graduation percentage does not apply to teamster work.

findings.title: Report submitted by 2028-12-31
findings.detail: Not yet submitted. 767 days remain from 2026-11-25. It must go to the appropriate policy and fiscal committees, in compliance with Gov. Code § 9795.

findings.title: Award after the report deadline
findings.detail: The award (2029-02-12) comes after the 2028-12-31 deadline. The statute sets a single report date and does not say how later projects are reported.

findings.title: Report covers all ten required items
findings.detail: Missing 3 of 10: Written protests and their resolution (§ 22185.8(b)(4)); Specialty subcontractors, by trade, that provided design services but did not meet the target price and did not build (§ 22185.8(b)(6)); Whether any design by such a subcontractor was used by the agency (§ 22185.8(b)(7)).
